builds.name: The Charmer
builds.desc:
Laslow's high naturally Atk makes him the perfect user of Brave Sword+. Since his Spd isn't high enough to quad-hit most units, instead we focus solely on boosting his Atk.
To start, +Atk is selected as Laslow's boon of choice. -Res is his chosen bane as his low Res and Spd mean most mages are going to be making quick work of him regardless.
His Atk is further supplemented with Death Blow as his A-slot passive. This maximizes the amount of Atk on the player phase that Laslow can achieve and puts him at a respectable 52 Atk when he initiates against enemies.
For his B-slot, since he already takes care of most greens effectively, we now want him to also take care of as many units of his own color as well. In short, we want Laslow to also be able to handle Red Swords as well. To do this, Swordbreaker is selected as his B-slot passive. This also serves as a slightly defensive option as the skill prevents other Red Sword users, most who have much higher Spd stats than Laslow, from doubling him.
His C-slot is typically flexible based on the rest of a player's team composition, but Threaten Defense will boost his individual performance and net him more kills. His default C-passive Hone Speed is also a solid option as well.
His Assist is also flexible, but a positioning skill such as Reposition is highly recommended to give more utility to the rest of his team.
